propositions: Extract identity transition call graph (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into BindingLifecycle while preserving all existing behaviors exactly.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on forward entry and pop only the differing old reverse key with no ambiguity detection or abort.
Stale reverse entries must be removed only in the four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind, re-key, and _retire.
Numeric-ID re-key must move issues by updating jira_key and resetting absent_404_count without retiring, while legacy no-ID records retain current behavior.
note_absent_or_rekey seam: re-key mutation (step 4 identity comparison and swap) moves to BindingLifecycle; facade remains coordinator for guard, client/ID checks, and fallthrough to note_absent.
